entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I want a refund, now.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
There is no 'issue'! I just changed my mind, okay? It was a complete impulse buy and I just don't use it. It's been sitting in the box. This is ridiculous, I want my money back.
Okay, I understand. Let me just pull up your account with your phone number... one moment... I see the order here. It looks like the band was delivered to you 23 days ago.
And? So what? Are you trying to get out of this? Don't even try to send me to some online resale marketplace. I'm not doing that. I bought it from you, you're taking it back. Get me your manager!
That won't be necessary, sir. I'm just confirming the policy on my end. Please hold for one moment while I double-check.
This is unbelievable. I'm already writing the one-star review in my head. 'VeloFit traps you into keeping products you don't want.' How does that sound?

My apologies for the delay. Okay, I've checked our system, and you are absolutely correct. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days, so you are well within the window. I can process this for you right away.
Oh. Well... okay. Good. Finally. So what's the next step?

I have just authorized the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account. You can just print that out, place the VeloBand back in its original packaging, and drop it off at the post office. Your full refund will be issued once we receive the item.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
